items.subtitle: Town in Phuket Island, Thailand
items.description: Patong is a beach resort town on the west coast of Phuket Island, facing the Andaman Sea in the southwest of Thailand. Its sandy, crescent beach is lined with cafes, restaurants and bars. The famously raucous nightlife scene features beer bars, go-go bars, nightclubs, massage parlors and cabarets that overflow into the street along neon-lit Bangla Road and in the Patong OTOP Shopping Paradise complex. ― Google

Patong in Phuket is `a major beach resort town on Thailand's west coast` , famous for Patong Beach, Bangla Road, and vibrant nightlife. It sits about 36 km (roughly a 45-minute drive) from Phuket International Airport.[](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Patong) [[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Patong)[[2]](https://www.thavornbeachvillage.com/tips-reasons-to-avoid-staying-in-patong-phuket)[[3]](https://www.thailandretreats.com/Location/Patong)[[4]](https://www.kayak.co.uk/holidays/thailand/patong-beach)

Beach and Activities

- **Patong Beach** : A 2 km stretch of golden sand offering water sports like jet-skiing and parasailing.
- **Freedom Beach** : A quieter, more scenic cove located just south of main Patong.[](https://www.thailandretreats.com/Location/Patong) [[1]](https://www.clubmed.com.au/l/blog/a-travel-guide-to-patong-beach-phuket)[[2]](https://www.getyourguide.com/en-gb/patong-l93618/ttd/)[[3]](https://www.hostelworld.com/blog/solo-travel-thailand-patong-24-hours/)[[4]](https://www.getyourguide.com/explorer/phuket-ttd32123/romantic-things-to-do-in-phuket/)

Nightlife and Entertainment

- **Bangla Road** : The bustling hub of neon-lit nightlife, filled with music bars, clubs, and street performances.
- **Simon Cabaret** : A popular musical stage show featuring glittering costume performances.
- **Bangla Boxing Stadium** : A venue to watch live Muay Thai fights.[](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Patong) [[1]](https://www.destination2.co.uk/destinations/thailand/phuket/patong)[[2]](https://www.hotels.com/go/thailand/phuket-patong)[[3]](https://uk.hotels.com/go/thailand/phuket-patong)

Practical Travel Info

- **Best Time to Visit** : November through February offers cooler, drier weather, while May to July brings the monsoon season.
- **Getting There** : Taxis from Phuket International Airport take about 45 minutes; it is best to agree on a fixed rate before departing.[](https://www.kayak.co.uk/holidays/thailand/patong-beach)
